title.es: was / were: el pasado de be

pattern.en: Were you tired? — Yes, I was.
We weren't in London last week.
pattern.ru: На прошлой неделе нас не было в Лондоне.

text.ru: Прошедшее от be: was (I, he, she, it) и were (we, you, they). Отрицание — wasn't / weren't, вопрос — Was it…? Were you…? Краткий ответ — Yes, I was. «Там было» — there was / there were.
text.en: Past of be: was (I, he, she, it), were (we, you, they). Negative: wasn't / weren't; question: Was it…? Were you…? “There was / there were”.
text.es: was / were. Negación: wasn't / weren't. there was / there were.

rule.formula: I / he / she / it was · we / you / they were

note.ru: в испанском «был» — это fue / estuvo / era в зависимости от смысла

exercises.en: There ___ a lot of people at the party.
Were your parents at home on Sunday?
exercises.ru: Твои родители были дома в воскресенье?

prompt.ru: Напишите, где вы были вчера и каким был день.
prompt.en: Write where you were yesterday and what the day was like.
prompt.es: Escribe dónde estuviste ayer y cómo fue el día.

exercises.sample: Yesterday I was at the office. It was a busy day.
